evidence.quote: We aim to constrain the radial extent of main deuterated species; we are particularly interested in spatially characterizing the high and low temperature pathways for enhancing deuteration of these species.

claims.hypothesis: DCN, N2D+ and DCO+ trace distinct deuteration regimes
claims.experiment: Radial ring abundance models fit to Keplerian-masked integrated intensity maps
claims.result: DCO+ needs three rings (50-118-245-316 AU); DCN ring 51-201 AU; N2D+ ring 139-287 AU
claims.finding: First two DCO+ rings correlate with high and low temperature pathways

evidence.quote: Our simple best-fit models show a correlation between the radial location of the first two rings in DCO$^+$ and the DCN and N$_2$D$^+$ abundance distributions

claims.hypothesis: Df values consistent with previous estimates
claims.experiment: Optically thin column densities and ratios with literature H13CO+, H13CN, N2H+
claims.finding: Agree with earlier values; N2D+ a good tracer of the cold outer disk

evidence.quote: The high N$_2$D$^+$/N$_2$H$^+$ confirms N$_2$D$^+$ as a good candidate for tracing ionization in the cold outer disk.

claims.hypothesis: Inner depression arises from optically thick dust
claims.experiment: Compared continuum brightness temperature with Isella2016
claims.result: Peak continuum 25 K here vs 55 K at higher resolution
claims.finding: Depression due to optically thick dust, not chemistry

evidence.quote: The corresponding brightness temperature for the peak intensity in these observations at higher spatial resolution is 55 K consistent with optically thick dust.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: DCO+ models with gaps between rings fit equally well; resolution cannot distinguish them

evidence.quote: The modest spatial resolution of our data cannot distinguish between these models.

limitations_admitted.value: N2D+ is weak, on edge of atmospheric feature, continuum subtraction less accurate

evidence.quote: The N$_2$D$^+$ ($J$=3–2) emission is sitting on the edge of a strong atmospheric feature at high $T_{\rm sys}$.

limitations_admitted.value: Isothermal vertical temperature assumption and no vertical abundance distribution

evidence.quote: A drawback of this approach is that assuming an isothermal vertical structure of the temperature profile might not properly describe the vertical region over which the molecules extend.
